QUOC(쿽)은 2009년 영국 런던에서 쿽 팜(Quoc Pham)이 설: QUOC is a cycling shoe brand founded in London in 2009 by Quoc Pham. Having wound down a menswear label, he was commuting daily on a single-speed and grew tired of his everyday shoes wearing out against the pedal's toe cage. A sturdy sole slim enough to fit the cage, and a leather upper that still looked right off the bike. From that simple idea came QUOC's first shoe, the Fixed England.
QUOC는 퍼포먼스를 숫자로만 보지 않습니다. 신발과 사람 사이의 감정적: QUOC doesn't measure performance in numbers alone. It starts from the emotional connection between people and their footwear, and from a shared love of riding. As a brand bridging cycling, culture and everyday life, QUOC balances elevated aesthetics with refined comfort so the rider can focus on nothing but the ride.
런던에서 시작된 독립 브랜드: An independent brand born in London
전 세계 300개 이상의 매장, 모든 대륙에서 신는 신발: Over 300 stores worldwide, worn on every continent
투르 드 프랑스 챔피언 게라인트 토마스가 신는 신발: Worn by Tour de France champion Geraint Thomas
매출의 1%를 환경을 위해 기부하는 인증 브랜드: A certified brand giving 1% of sales to the planet
QUOC의 신발은 자전거 위에서는 레이스 슈즈처럼 단단하고, 자전거에서: On the bike, a QUOC shoe is as firm as a race shoe. Off the bike, it looks like a well-made pair of shoes. Clean silhouettes instead of loud graphics, the colour border that became the brand's signature, an upper that wipes clean. The details are quiet, but they do their job every moment of the ride.
QUOC 팀은 모두가 라이더입니다. 모든 신발은 실제 조건의 긴 라이딩에: Everyone on the QUOC team rides. Every shoe is tested on long rides in real conditions, and feedback from competitive riders feeds into new lasts and uppers. More than a decade of that performance research made today's M3 and Gran Tourer.
좋은 신발은 존재감을 드러내지 않습니다. 발에 맞고, 라이딩에 녹아들고,: A good shoe doesn't call attention to itself. It fits, it blends into the ride, and then it's forgotten. That is how QUOC thinks about design.
월드투어의 피드백으로 다듬은 카본 솔과 랩 클로저. 레이스에 쓰이는 기술: A carbon sole and wrap closure refined with WorldTour feedback. Race technology, translated for everyday riding.
런던의 출퇴근길에서 그래블 바이크패킹까지. QUOC의 영감은 언제나 함께: From London commutes to gravel bikepacking. QUOC's inspiration always comes from the riders it rides with.
2018년 그란 투어러와 함께 등장한 컬러 보더는 QUOC를 한눈에 알아: Introduced with the Gran Tourer in 2018, the colour border became the signature that makes a QUOC recognisable at a glance.
“패션 산업에 지쳐 있던 20대 후반, 저를 다시 움직이게 한 것은 매일: “In my late twenties, worn out by the fashion industry, what got me moving again was the ride to work every morning.”
런던 도심에서 자란 쿽 팜은 남성복 레이블을 정리한 뒤 버몬지에서 싱글스: Raised in inner-city London, Quoc Pham wound down his menswear label and commuted from Bermondsey on a single-speed bike. Ordinary shoes wore through quickly against the pedal cages, so he decided to make his own. Taking an English-made last from his former label, he visited shoe factories in Asia and taught himself shoe development. The result was his first shoe, the Fixed England.
다섯 가지 컬러의 프로토타입을 들고 콘도르 사이클(Condor Cycle: He took prototypes in five colours to London bike shops including Condor Cycles, and sold 120 pairs in the first year. The brand that carried his name was soon shortened to QUOC.
2018년, 친구들과의 바이크패킹 여행에서 떠올린 그란 투어러(Gran: In 2018 he launched the Gran Tourer, conceived on a bikepacking trip with friends. It was the first gravel-specific shoe with a walkable sole, and the first to carry the colour border that became the brand's signature. It sold out almost immediately.
2023년 QUOC는 글로벌 팀을 갖추었고, 이듬해 팀이 종이에 적어 두: By 2023 QUOC had built a global team, and the following year it achieved a goal the team had written down: QUOC's first season with Tour de France champion Geraint Thomas. Today QUOC is sold in more than 300 stores around the world.
From racing to bikepacking, one pair for the way you ride.

M3는 QUOC가 10년 넘게 쌓아온 퍼포먼스 연구의 결과입니다. 경쟁: The M3 is the result of more than a decade of QUOC's performance research. A new last built from the feedback of competitive riders gives more support at the ball of the foot and more room at the toes, combining a natural fit with real support. The unidirectional carbon outsole, hand-laid and developed in-house, sends the rider's power straight to the pedal.

A tongue-free wrap closure and dual dials with parallel lace guides keep the foot locked in at peak effort. The M3 Air takes the same race platform and adds large mesh vents and an ultralight TPU upper for hot, high-intensity riding.

리브 구조의 사계절 어퍼로 발을 가장 단단히 잡아주는 M3입니다. 레이스: The M3 with the ribbed all-season upper that holds the foot most firmly. Racing, indoor and outdoor training, even winter, in one pair. Developed with Geraint Thomas.

긴 라이딩과 하이크어바이크 구간에서 발가락이 뭉치거나 열점이 생기지 않도: A wider toe box so toes don't bunch and hot spots don't form on long rides and hike-a-bike sections.
QUOC's signature colour border, reinterpreted as a wave-pattern reflective print. On dark roads, your feet are seen first.
